legal.data_processing_subtitle: How we process inquiries, orders, and AI-assisted features on this platform.
legal.data_processing_scope_body: Business contact details, company information, shipping and billing data, product selections, RFQ content, and documents you upload (e.g. specifications, payment proofs, KYB materials) are processed to operate the B2B OEM relationship: quotes, orders, compliance checks, logistics, and customer support.
legal.data_processing_ai_body: Where AI features are enabled, your text may be sent to configured model providers to generate summaries, suggestions, or search results. Outputs are informational only and do not replace professional legal, regulatory, or customs advice. You can disable public AI routes server-side via DISABLE_PUBLIC_AI_ROUTES.
legal.data_processing_retention_body: Retention periods follow operational and accounting needs and applicable law. Technical and organizational measures are applied as described in our Privacy Policy.
legal.data_processing_contact_body: Contact us using the details in the Privacy Policy for data-related requests.

privacy.intro: Welcome to CandyPro. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.
privacy.data_collect_desc: We may collect, use, store and transfer different kinds of personal data about you which we have grouped together as follows:
privacy.identity_data: Identity Data includes first name, last name, username or similar identifier.
privacy.contact_data: Contact Data includes billing address, delivery address, email address and telephone numbers.
privacy.use_data_desc: We will only use your personal data when the law allows us to. Most commonly, we will use your personal data in the following circumstances:
privacy.use_contract: Where we need to perform the contract we are about to enter into or have entered into with you.
privacy.use_legitimate: Where it is necessary for our legitimate interests (or those of a third party) and your interests and fundamental rights do not override those interests.
privacy.use_legal: Where we need to comply with a legal obligation.
